prompt: Admins in Jakarta and Singapore read different times for the same event. Four places in the private workspace format event times with the browser's own zone and locale: the Access activity feed, the Factory configuration history, the publication details and the "Copied at" line of a copied factory. Add `formatTimestamp(value: string): string` in `src/workspace/formatTimestamp.ts` that returns the product's standard display for a stored timestamp (text that cannot be parsed is shown as received), and use it in those four places so everyone sees the same text. Leave other screens as they are.
outOfScope: Other screens that format dates (delivery pages, pager 'Updated' time, demo company pages)
Stored timestamp values and API responses

lostDetail.fact: Users see dates and times in UTC, en-GB style (BUSINESS-NOTES.md, Business rules 14), not in the viewer's zone or locale.
